dialog.title: Change project
dialog.description: The machine keeps running. Usage up to now is booked to the current project, everything after it to the new one.

replaced.title: This session has changed
replaced.description: It ended or its project was changed elsewhere while this dialog was open. Close the dialog and check your session.

success.title: Project changed
success.noProject: Usage is no longer booked to a project.

projects.loadError: The projects could not be loaded.

ended.title: Session no longer running
ended.description: The session ended while you were choosing a project. The project was not changed here.

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.title: Insufficient balance
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: The project was not changed because the balance does not cover a new session.

PROJECT_SWITCH_FAILED.title: Project not changed
PROJECT_SWITCH_FAILED.description: The project was not changed. Technical details: {{error}}

PROJECT_SWITCH_DEVICE_FAILED.title: Project not changed
PROJECT_SWITCH_DEVICE_FAILED.description: The project was not changed because a connected device did not accept the change. Your session continues under the previous project. Technical details: {{error}}

PROJECT_SWITCH_UNCONFIRMED.title: Project change not confirmed
PROJECT_SWITCH_UNCONFIRMED.description: The server did not answer, so it is unknown whether the project was changed. Check the project shown for your session before trying again. Technical details: {{error}}

The session already belongs to this proj.title: Project not changed
The session already belongs to this proj.description: The project was not changed: the session already belongs to this project.

Only the owner of a running session can.title: Project not changed
Only the owner of a running session can.description: The project was not changed. Only the person whose session it is can change its project.

No active usage session found.title: Project not changed
No active usage session found.description: The project was not changed because this session is no longer running.

Project not found.title: Project not changed
Project not found.description: The project was not changed. The selected project no longer exists or you are no longer a member of it.

A usage lifecycle operation is already i.title: Project not changed
A usage lifecycle operation is already i.description: The project was not changed because another change to this machine's sessions is in progress. Try again in a moment.

MachineBusyError.title: Project not changed
MachineBusyError.description: The project was not changed because another change to this machine's sessions is in progress. Try again in a moment.

SessionChangeInterruptedError.title: Project not changed
SessionChangeInterruptedError.description: The project was not changed because the server was restarted during the change. Check the machine and try again.

Usage session changed during the project.title: Project not changed
Usage session changed during the project.description: The project was not changed because the session changed meanwhile. Check your session and try again.

The tentative usage session was cancelle.title: Project not changed
The tentative usage session was cancelle.description: The project was not changed because the session changed meanwhile. Check your session and try again.
